mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_im_config config INNER JOIN sys_tenant tenant ON tenant.tenant_id = config.tenant_id WHERE config.im_type = 'WECOM' AND config.deleted = 0 AND config.status = 'ENABLED' AND config.todo_enabled = 1 AND tenant.deleted = 0 AND tenant.status = '0' AND (tenant.expire_time IS NULL OR tenant.expire_time > NOW())
SELECT * FROM sys_im_todo_mapping WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND config_id = #{configId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND assignment_version = #{assignmentVersion} AND receiver_user_id = #{receiver}
SELECT * FROM sys_im_todo_mapping WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delivery_id = #{deliveryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_im_todo_mapping(tenant_id, config_id, task_id, assignment_version, receiver_user_id, im_type, im_user_id, card_key_hash, status, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES(#{tenantId}, #{configId}, #{taskId}, #{assignmentVersion}, #{receiverUserId}, 'WECOM', #{imUserId}, #{cardKeyHash}, 'PENDING', 0, 'im-todo', NOW(), 'im-todo', NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_im_todo_mapping SET delivery_id = #{deliveryId}, update_time = NOW(), update_by = 'im-todo' WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mapping_id = #{mappingId} AND delivery_id IS NULL AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE sys_im_todo_mapping SET status = #{status}, im_todo_id = COALESCE(#{providerId}, im_todo_id), version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(), update_by = 'im-todo' WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mapping_id = #{mappingId} AND version = #{version} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'SENT', 'UNKNOWN')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_im_todo_mapping WHERE mapping_id > #{after} AND delivery_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('PENDING', 'SENT', 'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY mapping_id LIMIT 100

SELECT todo.*, COALESCE(NULLIF(member.nick_name, ''), member.user_name, '已移除账号') AS receiver_name FROM sys_im_todo_mapping todo LEFT JOIN sys_user member ON member.tenant_id = todo.tenant_id AND member.user_id = todo.receiver_user_id AND member.deleted = 0 WHERE todo.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND todo.mapping_id = #{mappingId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_im_todo_mapping WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND config_id = #{configId}
